device.description: 10-bit 20 MSPS pipelined ADC with parallel TRI-STATE outputs and power down
device.note: adc10321.pdf (SNAS028F) p.2 connection diagram (32-pin TQFP), p.3-4 pin descriptions, p.5 operating ratings (VA, VD 4.5-5.5 V; VD I/O 2.7-5.5 V; PD, CLK, OE -0.3 to 5.5 V), p.7 digital input/output characteristics, p.7 AC characteristics (tOD 25 ns max from CLK fall, pipeline delay 2.0 clocks, fCLK 1-20 MHz), p.8 tEN/tDIS (typ), p.14 functional description (conversion every clock, OE, PD)

pages: p.2 connection diagram (32-pin TQFP), p.3-4 pin descriptions, p.5 operating ratings (VA, VD 4.5-5.5 V; VD I/O 2.7-5.5 V; PD, CLK, OE -0.3 to 5.5 V), p.7 digital input/output characteristics, p.7 AC characteristics (tOD 25 ns max from CLK fall, pipeline delay 2.0 clocks, fCLK 1-20 MHz), p.8 tEN/tDIS (typ), p.14 functional description (conversion every clock, OE, PD)
notModeled: analog input and reference ladder (the result is always the 0 V code 0x000; 0 V is below the VREF- range, so it reads code 0)
pipeline latency of 2.0 clock cycles (the code is constant); VIN sampled on CLK falling, data valid tOD after CLK falling
PD high also puts D0-D9 in TRI-STATE (the model's powerdown pin only blocks conversions; OE alone gates the outputs); 700 ns wake-up
OE enable/disable times tEN 25 ns / tDIS 18-25 ns (typical only) are not modeled
clock frequency limits (1-20 MHz) and loss of accuracy when the clock stops
CLK, OE and PD are referenced to VD (4.5-5.5 V, TTL thresholds VIH 2.0 V / VIL 1.0 V), the outputs to VD I/O (2.7-5.5 V); vcc is the union 2.7-5.5 V
